title: Finish shopping list document assembly and file output
description: Complete the orchestration service so it builds the ShoppingListDocument meals and aisle sections, performs duplicate-name protection, and writes the rendered markdown to the shopping-lists folder.
acceptance_criteria: Generated document title uses the user-selected list name.
`## Meals` bullets are emitted in plan order as `**<block heading>** — <recipe display name>` for recipe occurrences only.
Aggregated aisles are converted into shopping-list aisles, with unnamed aisles written as `Other` and items formatted via `ShoppingListLineFormatter`.
Target path resolves to `<folder>/shopping-lists/<sanitised>.md`, duplicate names raise `CreateError.listAlreadyExists`, and successful creation writes the markdown through existing file helpers.

handoff_summary.completed: All four acceptance criteria met: (1) document title = sanitised user-provided name; (2) ## Meals bullets in plan order, recipe occurrences only, format **<block heading> — <display name>**; (3) aggregated aisles applied via AggregatedShoppingList.apply(to:) with nil→"Other" and entryText formatting; (4) path resolves to <folder>/shopping-lists/<sanitised>.md, listAlreadyExists guard, ShoppingListFiles.writeText write.
handoff_summary.risks: ShoppingListLineFormatter is referenced in the acceptance criteria but does not exist as a separate type; formatting is instead handled by AggregatedItem.entryText (defined in Aggregation.swift). The behaviour is correct but the name is inconsistent with the AC wording — downstream reviewer should confirm this is acceptable.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify duplicate-name guard, meals-bullet ordering, aisle-to-Other mapping, and file-write path under unit tests.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — only CreateShoppingListFromMealPlanService.swift touched; no shared model types modified.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Sanitisation mirrors ShoppingListsView.handleCreate: trimCharacters(in:.whitespaces) + replacingOccurrences("/","-"). The sanitised value is used for both the filename and the ShoppingListDocument title, matching the view layer's behaviour. ShoppingListLineFormatter is not introduced as a separate type; AggregatedItem.entryText in Aggregation.swift fulfils the same role.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests added (developer scope). Tester agent should cover: (a) sanitised filename vs raw name; (b) listAlreadyExists thrown when file pre-exists; (c) meals bullets order; (d) nil-aisle mapped to Other.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Security-scoped resource access for the output URL is delegated to ShoppingListFiles.writeText, which calls startAccessingSecurityScopedResource on the output URL. The subfolder URL returned by shoppingListsURL is not a bookmarked URL, so the access may be a no-op — this is consistent with existing ShoppingListsView behaviour and is not a regression.

conflict_risks: None — only CreateShoppingListFromMealPlanService.swift touched; no shared model types modified.

execution_history.summary: Added filename sanitization to CreateShoppingListFromMealPlanService. The prior implementation was otherwise complete: meals bullets, aisle conversion via AggregatedShoppingList.apply(to:), duplicate-name guard, and file write were all in place. The only missing piece was that `name` was used raw in the output URL and document title; a two-line sanitize (trim whitespace, replace `/` with `-`) consistent with the ShoppingListsView pattern was added, and `ShoppingListDocument(title:)` now also receives the sanitised value.
